name: frontend-design
title_zh: 把设计直觉编译成生产级前端代码
tagline_zh: 告别千篇一律的 AI 模板风，让每个组件都像出自资深设计师之手。从布局到动效，代码即作品。
tagline_en: Break free from generic AI aesthetics—craft interfaces that feel art-directed, from layout to micro-interaction.
desc_en: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
why_zh: 不止生成代码，而是内置设计决策引擎：对比度、间距节奏、视觉层级，让产物自带高级感。
why_en: It's not just codegen—it embeds design judgment: contrast, spacing rhythm, visual hierarchy, so output feels art-directed, not.
limit_zh: 仅适用于前端界面（HTML/CSS/JS/React 等），不处理后端逻辑、数据建模或部署；若需求超出界面范畴。
limit_en: Frontend UI only (HTML/CSS/JS/React). No backend, data modeling, or deployment—if asked, it stops and asks to split the task.
